description: This file contains the implementation of the Orleans silo, including its lifecycle management, initialization, startup, shutdown procedures, and logging. It defines the Silo class with methods to start, stop, and manage the silo's runtime state, as well as associated internal classes and logging helpers.

classes.name: Silo
classes.description: Represents an Orleans silo, managing its lifecycle, initialization, and shutdown procedures, as well as providing access to silo-specific properties and services.

classes.name: LifecycleSchedulingSystemTarget
classes.description: A dummy system target used for scheduling silo lifecycle tasks.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Begins the asynchronous startup process of the silo, queuing the OnStart lifecycle method.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Initiates the asynchronous shutdown of the silo, handling both graceful and immediate termination.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the silo, ensuring proper shutdown.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Synchronously disposes of the silo, calling StopAsync internally.
